name: Ravenry Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Handle Animal (Cha)

Basic Study Ability
Rookery (Ex)

You are an expert at sending messages by raven. You can use animal messenger at will as an extraordinary ability.

If you use this ability with a raven (or similar bird, as approved by your GM) that you have previously trained for the task, the use of this ability does not expend inspiration. (Training a raven typically requires one day and a successful DC 20 Handle Animal check; if you have at least 10 ranks in Handle Animal, you need only work with a raven for 1 hour instead of 1 day.) If you use this ability with any other appropriate animal, you must expend 1 point of inspiration.

If you successfully send a message by animal messenger, you can make a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check through that message. This functions as normal for the skill used, except that you must wait for the animal to deliver the message and, if appropriate, return with the reply.

Additionally, if you make a DC 15 Knowledge (local) check as part of a message sent by raven to an organization, government, or other group of people that you are affiliated with, you can gain the obligation of their hospitality in advance for yourself and your party. Provided you have influence with the party contacted, you can expect a hospitable welcome, basic lodging, and food at no expense for you and your party when you arrive.

Associated Technique
Flanking Technique (Ex)

When flanking an opponent you have studied with this technique, you gain an additional +1 bonus to your attack roll. If the ally flanking with you is an animal you have trained or your animal companion, it also gains this bonus.

These bonuses further increase by 1 at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Call Ravens (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Rookery study ability, scholar level 13th.

Once per day, you can expend 1 point of inspiration as a full-round action to summon a raven swarm B6. The ravens arrive as if conjured by the spell summon swarm, except that they must be able to fly in from the sky or through an open window or other portal of some kind. The caster level for this spell-like ability is equal to your ranks in Handle Animal. When the duration ends, any surviving ravens will fly away in the same way from which they came.

Raven Familiar (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Rookery study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain an exceptional raven as a familiar. You use your ranks in Handle Animal as your effective wizard level to determine the abilities of your familiar.

Raven Shape (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Rookery study ability, scholar level 9th.

You can assume the form of a raven once per day. This functions as beast shape II except that the duration is equal to a maximum of 10 minutes per rank you have in Handle Animal. When you reach 18 ranks in Handle Animal, you can use this ability twice per day.

Wings of the Raven (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Rookery study ability, scholar level 4th.

Once per day, by expending a point of inspiration, you can use raven’s flight as a spell-like ability as a swift action. You gain an additional daily use of this ability when you reach 10 and 16 ranks in Handle Animal. Each use of this ability requires the expenditure of a point of inspiration.
